a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.

About the Rusty Spokes Thursday Easy Trail Ride group ride

Rusty Spokes Thursday Easy Trail Ride is a social group ride in Omaha, NE. It rolls every Thursday at 10:00 am from Karen Park, 62nd and Buckingham Ave.

An easy morning ride on the Keystone Trail, called Rusty Spokes. It is led by club members and open to the public.
